DETERMINATION OF OXYDEMETON.METHYL CONTENT
A-o. PRINCIPLE A-o.I Oxydemeton-methyl content is determined by saponification "I the material with sodium hydroxide, followed by back titration of the exc e-", alkali. A correction is made for free acidity. A�I. APPARATUS

A�1.1 eom-t Flask joint and stopper.
A-I.2 Magaetic Stirrer Aol.3 Burette -

300 m1 capacity, fitted with ground-glass con e-

50 ml capacity.

A-1.4 Pipette - 50 ml capacity. A�1.5 Cnnieal Flask - 300 mI capacity, wide- mouthed ,
A�2. REAGENTS

-;- ~-2.1 Standard Sodium Hydroxide Solution A-2.2 Standard Hydrochloric Acid Soluaon -

0'1 N. 0'1 N.

A-2.3 Methyl Red Indicator Solution
A-3. PROCEDURE A-3.1 Weigh accurately a sufficient amount of sample containing 0'4 to 0'5 g of active ingredient and transfer to the conical flask. Pipette in 50 ml ofstandard sodium hydroxide solutron. Stopper the flask and stir at 2?OC for 30 minutes by means of a magnetic stirrer, Titrate the excess sodium hydroxide With standard hydrochloric acid solution.
A.3.2 Weigh accurately 3'0 t04'0 g of the sample into a 300-ml wide-mouth. ed conical flask. Add 100 ml of d istilled water and few drops of methyl red indicator solution. cool to lOoe and titrate quickly with standard sodium hydroxide solution till the colour changes from red to yellow,
